issues.description: The pattern /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/ allows consecutive dots and doesn't properly validate domain structure, allowing invalid emails like 'a@b.c' or 'test@invalid.'
Error message combines multiple validation failures making it difficult for API consumers to determine which field is missing
Using Math.random() has poor entropy and concatenation is inefficient. Could lead to ID collisions in high-throughput scenarios
sanitizeInput doesn't validate input length or check for null/undefined, which could cause runtime issues
Only name field is sanitized; email should also be validated against XSS payloads to prevent stored XSS
Function doesn't verify input is an object before accessing properties
The saveUser function is stubbed out with commented code, suggesting incomplete implementation
If saveUser fails silently, the function returns a user that wasn't actually saved

suggestions.description: Group isValidEmail, sanitizeInput, and createUser into a UserService class following Single Responsibility Principle
suggestions.benefits: Encapsulates user-related logic into cohesive class, Improves testability through dependency injection, Easier to mock database dependencies, Better separation of concerns

suggestions.description: Use 'uuid' package instead of Date.now() + Math.random() concatenation
suggestions.benefits: Eliminates collision risk, Cryptographically secure random generation, Industry standard UUID format, Reduces maintenance burden

suggestions.description: Use 'email-validator' package instead of custom regex
suggestions.benefits: RFC 5322 compliant validation, Handles international domains and special cases, Eliminates false positives/negatives, Reduces maintenance

suggestions.description: Use 'xss' package instead of manual HTML entity escaping
suggestions.benefits: Comprehensive XSS prevention, Handles more attack vectors, Maintained by security experts, Covers edge cases and new vulnerabilities

suggestions.description: Extract database logic into a separate UserRepository class injected as dependency
suggestions.benefits: Enables testability with mock database, Allows swapping different storage backends, Reduces global dependencies, Follows SOLID principles

suggestions.description: Extract inline validation logic into separate UserInputValidator class
suggestions.benefits: Separates validation concerns from business logic, Enables reusable validation rules, Returns all validation errors at once, Easier to test validation independently

suggestions.description: Create separate factory method for user object creation
suggestions.benefits: Improves readability of createUser, Centralizes user object construction, Easier to test object creation separately, Facilitates adding/changing fields

suggestions.description: Replace chained replace() calls with declarative entity mapping
suggestions.benefits: More declarative character mapping, Easier to add new entities, Clearer intent
Prevents whitespace-only submissions, Better data quality, Cleaner validation logic

recommendations.description: Implement comprehensive test suite for fixtures/clean-code.ts. File has 0% test coverage with critical security-related functions (sanitizeInput, createUser) that must be thoroughly tested.
Replace custom email validation regex with dedicated library. Current regex is too permissive and doesn't properly validate domain structure per RFC 5322 standards.
Upgrade ID generation to use cryptographically secure method. Current Math.random() + timestamp concatenation could lead to collisions.
Extract UserService class to encapsulate user management logic. Group isValidEmail, sanitizeInput, and createUser into cohesive class with dependency injection for database access.
Improve input sanitization with dedicated XSS library. Current manual HTML entity escaping may miss edge cases and new attack vectors.
Improve error messages to be specific about which field is missing or invalid. Generic error messages reduce debuggability for API consumers.
Add input type guards and edge-case handling. Function lacks null/undefined checks and sanitizeInput doesn't validate input length.
Implement explicit error handling around database save operation. Currently no error handling if saveUser fails.
Complete database implementation or clearly document as fixture/mock. The commented db.query line suggests incomplete work.
